content: Empirical (openpyxl 3.1.5 + SheetJS 0.18.5 reader used by ProbeMatrix importer): a str value starting with '=' is stored as a formula (data_type f, empty <v/>), which SheetJS reads as null, so String(x||'') yields '' (blank Description = whole-file rejection). Setting cell.data_type='s' after assignment writes an inlineStr that SheetJS reads correctly. '+','-','@' prefixes stay strings. datetime.date becomes an Excel serial (44091). Ints >15 digits lose precision. Numeric 0 becomes '' via ||. openpyxl raises IllegalCharacterError for control chars \x00-\x08,\x0b,\x0c,\x0e-\x1f and silently truncates strings to 32,767 chars.
